mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS post_id, pan.nickname, p.location_id, l.si_do, l.si_gun_gu, p.content, p.created_at, CASE WHEN pl.user_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS likeYN, CASE WHEN p.user_id = #{userId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMine, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes WHERE post_id = p.id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments WHERE post_id = p.id AND status = 'ACTIVE') AS commentCount, p.status FROM posts p LEFT JOIN post_anonymous_nickname pan ON pan.post_id = p.id AND pan.user_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN locations l ON l.id = p.location_id LEFT JOIN post_likes pl ON pl.post_id = p.id AND pl.user_id = #{userId} WHERE p.id = #{postId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE id = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{postId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, location_id, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{locationId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM post_likes WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_likes WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT nickname FROM post_anonymous_nickname WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_anonymous_nickname (post_id, user_id, nickname) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{nickname})
mapper.select: SELECT et.id, et.name, et.emoji, COUNT(*) AS count FROM post_emotion_tag pet JOIN posts p ON p.id = pet.post_id JOIN emotion_tags et ON et.id = pet.emotion_id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.created_at >= #{since} GROUP BY et.id, et.name, et.emoji ORDER BY count DESC, et.id ASC
